description: Source code implementing TLS CBC padding removal, MAC copying, and SHA1 digest functions with cryptographic operations, including constant-time checks for security.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_remove_padding
methods.description: Removes TLS CBC padding in constant time, verifies padding correctness, and outputs the padding length.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_copy_mac
methods.description: Copies and rotates the MAC from a TLS record, handling variable MAC positions securely.

methods.name: EVP_sha1_final_with_secret_suffix
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash with an additional secret suffix, in constant time, for cryptographic security.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_record_digest_supported
methods.description: Checks if the provided message digest algorithm is SHA1, supported for TLS CBC digest.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_digest_record
methods.description: Computes the TLS CBC record digest (MAC) using SHA1, with constant-time operations to prevent side-channel attacks.
